::: {.tagline}
Math and Data Science for Fire & EMS
:::

<!-- Alternative tagline: "Statistics, simulation, and optimization for public safety" -->

I'm a fire data analyst at Cobb County Fire & Emergency Services in Georgia, where I work with an amazing team in the Fire Planning Division. Together we build and run the department's reporting systems and analytics, and I apply statistics, optimization, and GIS to planning questions such as where to place resources to best serve the community.

I also run [Kaido Analytics LLC](about.qmd), a small consultancy for statistical analysis and reproducible reporting, and I'm finishing a BS in Mathematics with a concentration in statistics at Kennesaw State University.
